Cover Letter Generator

Write a tailored cover letter in seconds — enter the role, company, and your skills; get a polished letter to copy or download.

Your letter will appear here.

Template only — personalize the details and proofread before sending.

📖 How to use

  1. Fill in the role, company, and your skills.
  2. Choose a tone and add an optional opening line.
  3. Generate, then copy or download.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What do I need to enter?

Your name, the role, the company, your top skills, and years of experience — the letter weaves them into a tailored draft.

What tones are available?

Enthusiastic, Professional, or Concise — pick the tone that fits the company.

Can I add a custom opening?

Yes — add your own opening line to make the letter stand out.

How do I use the letter?

Copy it into your application or download it as a .txt file.
